intent: Implement an optional secure node-local archive cache for Kubernetes scale-out
Build verified content storage and concurrent fill coordination

name: Node cache blob store
role: Stores verified content-addressed blobs in a private directory and coalesces concurrent fills in one process
conditions: Every caller must authorize access before calling the store; total disk limits, eviction, endpoint routing and service authentication remain unimplemented

subject: Cache integrity
why: Verify size and SHA-256 before atomic publication and on each hit; a partial or corrupt file must not reach the JVM

title: Use verified digest-addressed files and coordinate concurrent fills
why: Digest checks and atomic publication protect consumers while per-digest coordination avoids duplicate downloads in a burst
alternative: Independent per-request downloads and unverified files — rejected: they multiply transfers and can expose incomplete data

intent: Authorize node cache requests using Kubernetes identities and explicit grants

name: Node cache authorization
role: Validates service-account tokens through Kubernetes TokenReview and checks exact subject, registry and repository grants
conditions: Each request needs review and an explicit operator grant; the service endpoint and registry authorization are not implemented yet

subject: Token review audience
why: Reject reviews without the intended audience, reread the reviewer token for rotation, and never follow API redirects with credentials

title: Require token review and explicit repository grants for cache access
why: An authenticated identity must have an explicit grant before it can access shared private archive bytes
alternative: Anonymous node-local access — rejected: workloads on the same node could read each other's archives
